slides.s: PMP-Certified Engineering Leader | AI-Driven Engineering Transformation | 21+ Years Experience
slides.n: Please welcome {name}, a PMP-certified engineering leader with over two decades of experience building high-performing teams and delivering enterprise-scale products across software, testing, and DevOps.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul 2025-Sep 2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIG-IP control plane services, drove a security-hardening initiative reducing 100+ long-lived defects/CVEs, and cut upgrade time by ~90% while leading agentic AI adoption for issue resolution.

Cisco Systems India · Mar 2020-Jul 2025 — Led architecture and delivery of distributed services integrating Webex Calling and Meetings with Microsoft Teams using TypeScript/React, Kafka, Redis, and Java; drove AI-based code generation for Webex SDKs.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2018-Feb 2020 — Led Cisco Expressway VoIP gateway development and CI/CD release engineering using Jenkins, Kubernetes, Docker and OpenStack, managing 10+ major and 30+ minor product releases.
Cisco Systems India · Apr 2008-Feb 2018 — Led QA activities and Python-based test automation for Cisco Call Manager, Expressway and VoIP solutions, mentoring QA teams and driving Agile adoption.
Verizon India Pvt Ltd · May 2007-Mar 2008 — Performed end-to-end call-flow and regression testing for IP-converged contact center solutions including IVR and automated call routing.
slides.n: {Her} path, wait, his path spans from hands-on QA engineering at Verizon and Cisco to leading engineering teams at Cisco and F5, consistently driving automation, platform modernization, and AI-enabled transformation.
{name} brings a rare blend of deep technical skill and leadership, spanning AI-driven automation, cloud DevOps practices, and strong grounding in networking and VoIP protocols.
Over the course of his career, {name} has delivered measurable impact, including a 90 percent reduction in upgrade time and resolution of over 100 long-lived customer defects and CVEs.

{His} educational foundation includes a B.E. in Electronics and Communication, a PMP certification, and a recent postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Texas at Austin.
Thank you for learning about {name}'s journey — a career defined by technical leadership, innovation, and a passion for driving AI-enabled transformation in engineering teams.
